statement: Runpod Secure Cloud lists B300 on-demand rental at $7.89 per GPU-hour.
why: A current listed rental level for the newest part, with no prior price stated, so it is a level and not a move.

impact.mechanism: Display overlay only: a static rental level with no baseline gives no direction on demand or supply.

confidence.basis: Single vendor pricing page read at fetch time; no historical series on the page.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 1.59 -> 7.89 (tol 1%); sources: Runpod
